about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Ethiopia's discovery platform — connecting skilled people, businesses, and services with the people who need them.

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.body: GebetaPro was built to make it easier for talented individuals and growing businesses across Ethiopia to get discovered. Whether you are a freelancer, a shop owner, or running a large enterprise, we give you a professional profile that puts you in front of the right audience.

story.heading: Our story
story.body: We started with a simple observation: finding reliable local services in Ethiopia was still largely word-of-mouth. GebetaPro changes that by building a structured, searchable directory that works for everyone — from Addis Ababa to Hawassa, Gondar to Bahir Dar.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: GebetaPro ("we", "us", or "our") operates the GebetaPro platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our services.

collect.heading: 1. Information we collect
collect.intro: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
collect.item1: Account registration details (name, email address, password)
collect.item2: Profile information (business name, description, phone number, location, images)
collect.item3: Payment information processed securely through our payment provider
collect.auto: We also collect certain information automatically, such as your IP address, browser type, and pages visited, to operate and improve our platform.

use.heading: 2. How we use your information
use.item1: To create and manage your account and profile
use.item3: To display your profile to other users in the directory
use.item4: To send transactional emails (verification, password reset, receipts)
use.item5: To improve platform features and user experience

share.heading: 3. Sharing of information
share.body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating the platform (e.g. payment processors, email delivery services), subject to strict confidentiality obligations. We may also disclose information when required by law.

public.heading: 4. Public profile data
public.body: Information you add to your public profile — such as your business name, description, location, phone number, services, and images — is visible to all visitors of the platform. Be mindful of what you choose to publish.

security.heading: 5. Data security
security.body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and secure password hashing. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

rights.heading: 6. Your rights
rights.item1: Access and update your personal information via your dashboard
rights.item2: Request deletion of your account and associated data
rights.item3: Opt out of marketing communications at any time

contact.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, reach us at

terms.intro: By accessing or using GebetaPro, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.

accounts.heading: 1. Accounts
accounts.body: You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorised access.

content.heading: 2. User content
content.body: You retain ownership of content you post on GebetaPro. By posting, you grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to display that content as part of operating the platform.
content.responsibility: You are solely responsible for ensuring your content:
content.item2: Does not infringe any third-party intellectual property rights
content.item3: Does not contain offensive, illegal, or harmful material

prohibited.heading: 3. Prohibited conduct
prohibited.item1: Use the platform for any unlawful purpose
prohibited.item2: Post false, fraudulent, or impersonated profiles
prohibited.item3: Attempt to gain unauthorised access to any part of the platform

subscriptions.heading: 4. Subscriptions and payments
subscriptions.body: Some features require a paid subscription. All fees are stated in Ethiopian Birr (ETB) unless otherwise noted. Payments are processed through our third-party payment provider. Subscription fees are non-refundable except where required by applicable law.

termination.heading: 5. Termination
termination.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or that we reasonably believe pose a risk to the platform or other users. You may delete your account at any time from your dashboard.

disclaimer.body: GebetaPro is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the platform will be uninterrupted, error-free, or free of viruses or other harmful components.
